{{Top}}
'''Sleeping powder''' was a substance which induced sleep after coming in contact with the skin of an individual. It was employed by the [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] to knock individuals unconscious. The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Zarrak]] once used sleeping powder to cause [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] to fall asleep so that she would be unable to warn her friends of his dark past.
